policy.reversibility: Every row preserves the source label verbatim alongside its mapping, so the corpus can be re-derived forward and any enrichment value can be traced back to the labels that contributed to it.
policy.corpus_untouched: Applying this ledger is a join at read time. No value in unified_scripture_corpus.jsonl is altered, and spelling variants keep the source's own spelling.
policy.forbidden_axes_reason: Source annotations describe what the text expresses. None of them measures which user state a verse serves, and none is entitled to certify pastoral suitability. Both prohibitions are asserted at build time.
policy.approval: Rows are emitted as `proposed`. A row carries evidence weight only once a human reviewer sets status to `approved`.
